title: Can You Put Parchment Paper in an Air Fryer?

seo.title: Can You Put Parchment Paper in an Air Fryer?
seo.meta_description: Parchment can be used in some air fryers if the manufacturer allows it, food weighs it down, and it does not block airflow or touch the heating element.
seo.search_intent: Understand when parchment paper is safe in an air fryer and how to keep it from lifting, scorching, or blocking circulation.

excerpt: Parchment should never sit loose in an operating air fryer. The fan can lift it toward the heating element, and an oversized sheet can restrict the airflow the appliance needs.
content_html:
Parchment works in many air fryers only when the manufacturer permits it and food keeps it securely in place. An empty sheet during preheating can be blown upward toward the heater.

Do not blanket the entire basket

Air fryers cook by moving hot air. Covering all openings changes that airflow and can reduce cooking performance. Size the paper to the food rather than sealing the basket floor.

Add parchment with the food

Do not preheat with a lightweight sheet sitting by itself. Put the parchment in when you add enough food to hold it down.

Keep edges away from the heater

Avoid tall corners or curled paper that can lift. Parchment is heat resistant only within its rated temperature and can scorch if it touches a heating element.

Check the paper’s temperature rating

Stay below the limit printed by the paper manufacturer, and do not confuse parchment with wax paper.

Basket design varies. If your air-fryer manual prohibits paper or calls for a specific perforated liner, follow that model-specific instruction.

faq.question: Can I preheat with parchment in the basket?
faq.answer: Not if the paper is loose; airflow can lift it toward the heater.

faq.question: Does parchment need holes?
faq.answer: That depends on the basket and manufacturer, but it should not block the airflow path.

faq.question: Is wax paper the same as parchment?
faq.answer: No. Wax paper is not a substitute for heat-rated parchment in an air fryer.
